about: Known-answer files for the encrypted backup format (PLBK version 1). Made once, on 2026-11-16, by the two encryption versions in use before step 1.4 (both last changed in a3d5571). Never remake them: every later version must still open these exact files (test/backup-kat.test.js, test-ui/backup-crypto.js). The files end in .plbk, not .db.enc, because .gitignore keeps real encrypted backups (*.db.enc) out of git.
